name: Artist
summary: Uses evidence-backed ecological summaries to create daily artwork.
description: Creates the daily art output from evidence-backed ecological summaries. Consumes a constrained local species set and confidence-backed detections so the artwork reflects the observed soundscape at a real location instead of an unconstrained imaginary fauna list.

distinguished_from.how: Owns the place-specific recording policy and candidate species scope; does not create the artistic output from the resulting evidence.
Interprets uncertain or unknown detections for database improvement; does not produce the final artistic rendering.
